target_customer: Pharma and biotech partners developing siRNA, mRNA and antisense therapeutics that need delivery beyond the liver; revenue would come from licensing and partnerships.
problem: RNA drugs are hard to deliver to tissues other than the liver, with existing carriers either toxic or complex to engineer.
business_model: Platform licensing and partnerships plus own preclinical programs (Mergo RNA delivery platform)

founders.name: Anna Perdrix Rosell
founders.background_notes: Oncologist per company team page; a secondary database lists PhD work at Cambridge and the Crick, unverified.

founders.name: George Foot
founders.background_notes: Plant scientist per company team page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Designing programmable delivery systems for RNA that target non liver tissues is research grade chemistry and biology needing years of preclinical validation.

defensibility.rationale: Patented delivery systems and hard to replicate science, though the field is crowded with well funded players.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying Sixfold; the company remains independent and preclinical as of 2025.

market_need_then: Delivery of RNA therapeutics beyond the liver was described by the founders as an overlooked problem in 2017 that few wanted to solve; interest in RNA drugs grew rapidly after 2020.

branding.domain_note: Uses sixfold.bio, not a .com; the exact sixfold.com belongs to an unrelated insurance software company.

identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific and plain; platform branded Mergo.

branding.brand_signature: Mergo, the registered name of its RNA delivery platform

brand_strength.rationale: Trade press coverage of the seed and a named platform, but no consumer or community brand and a name shared with other companies; brand matters little in biotech.

outcome_analysis: Sixfold was started from scratch by an oncologist and a plant scientist, entered YC in Winter 2018, and raised a 10.5 million dollar seed in December 2021 plus a UK Biomedical Catalyst grant in 2023, with no later priced round found. It remains independent and preclinical with a Mergo platform and conference activity in 2025. A UK filing based profile suggests headcount fell to 8 in 2025 with low cash, which is unconfirmed, so the company may be constrained by the long timeline and capital needs of preclinical RNA delivery.
notes: Company site sixfold.bio returned HTTP 503 and the BusinessWire page returned 403 at fetch time; seed details come from search snippets across BusinessWire, Fierce Pharma, BioWorld and Cambridge Network, which agree on 10.5 million dollars (some list 10.4 or 10.49). Founding year conflicts (2017 per founders and databases, 2018 per Companies House registration, YC page says 2018). FundedIQ mentions an 8.3 million dollar grant in December 2021, seen only once and not recorded. Headcount of 8 in 2025 and cash figures come from an unverified profile and are not confirmed layoffs. No competitor sources dated near the Winter 2018 batch were found, so the list is empty. Some databases name an extra co-founder, Zuzanna Aleksandra Brzosko, which the company page does not.
